Leakage found and removed: risk_score. These columns were derived from the target — they score brilliantly in cross-validation but would be unavailable (or meaningless) in production. Dropping them is what makes the reported metrics honest.
Champion model: logistic (sklearn). The five strongest features are support_intensity (0.29), support_tickets (0.28), engagement_score (0.27), logins_last_month (0.24), tenure_log (0.19). At the Youden threshold of 0.30, the model finds 79% of churners at 51% precision.
